title: Quality Board from a great company
text: Quality Board from a great company. Once again, Gorilla products prove to be awesome! Thick, heavy, durable cutting boards. Great rim for catching juice/liquid. Grippy, safe, sturdy cutting board. Will probably never need to buy another. Dishwasher and done!

product_metadata.title: The Original Gorilla Grip Durable Kitchen Cutting Board Set of 3, BPA Free, Large Dishwasher Safe Reversible Plastic Boards, Nonslip Handle and Border, Deep Grooves, Chopping Food, Meat, Almond Gray
features: Ultra Durable and Built To Last: unlike wood or bamboo, these thick, nonporous boards are incredibly durable; won’t splinter, crack or peel, even after many washes; no oiling or maintenance necessary; deep juice grooves help capture runoff liquid from messy ingredients; rubber border helps provide a secure grip on countertops; food grade and a great choice for all homes
Stays in Place During Prep: make food prep easier than ever with the most durable cutting board; its slip resistant handle and rubber border help to reduce slipping and sliding on countertop surfaces

Larger and Thicker Than Others: 3 generously sized boards are extra thick; largest board measures 16 by 11.2 inches; medium board measures 13.8 by 9.6 inches; small board measures 11.8 by 8 inches; each board is .37 inches thick and combined, weigh 4.25 pounds; other boards are just .3 inches thick and weigh as little as 2.9 pounds
BPA Free and Food Grade: each board is tested to comply with US regulations, food grade and food safe; wash in the dishwasher time after time and boards will not break down

Reversible Design with Deep Juice Grooves: each Gorilla Grip Cutting Board features a reversible design that allows you to chop on both sides to help prevent flavor mingling; boards also feature deep juice grooves on one side to help prevent countertop mess by catching runoff juices
